function.name: web_close_tab
function.description: Close the active browser tab or a tab by stable tab_ref from web_list_tabs. Returns a fresh post-action observation when enabled: path-free page state, latest refs/Set-of-Mark grounding, a clean page image, and for spatial actions an action-overlay history image. Images are attached to this tool result only when prompt image budget allows.

parameters.description:
Arguments for ``web_close_tab``.

Attributes:
    tab_ref: Optional stable tab id or label. When omitted, the active tab
        is closed.

tab_ref.description: Stable tab id or label from web_list_tabs. Omit to close the active tab.
tab_ref.title: Tab Ref

parameters.title: WebCloseTabParams

function.name: web_focus_tab
function.description: Switch focus to a browser tab by stable tab ref from web_list_tabs. Returns a fresh post-action observation when enabled: path-free page state, latest refs/Set-of-Mark grounding, a clean page image, and for spatial actions an action-overlay history image. Images are attached to this tool result only when prompt image budget allows.

parameters.description:
Arguments for ``web_focus_tab``.

Attributes:
    tab_ref: Stable tab id or label from ``web_list_tabs``.

tab_ref.description: Stable tab id or label from web_list_tabs, such as t1 or a label created by web_new_tab.
tab_ref.title: Tab Ref
